jobs.employer_name: Heraeus Consulting & IT Solutions GmbH, HRdirekt
jobs.description:
As Enterprise Architect – Strategic Domains (m/f/d), you will help shape the future Enterprise Architecture practice within the Heraeus Group, with a particular focus on strategically important business and IT domains.

You will work at the interface of business strategy, IT roadmap and transformation portfolio, creating transparency, direction and architectural guidance for complex cross-domain topics.

Your key responsibilities will include:

- Shaping and evolving enterprise architecture practices across strategically relevant domains, ensuring alignment with business priorities, IT strategy and long-term transformation goals.
- Developing capability- and location-spanning reference architectures and strategic target architectures that provide clear orientation for future business and IT decisions.
- Supporting portfolio and investment decisions with architectural impact assessments, transparency and pragmatic recommendations.
- Coaching business and IT stakeholders in top-down architecture planning and helping translate strategic objectives into clear architectural priorities and roadmaps.
- Contributing to the further development of architecture governance, principles, standards and guardrails to enable consistent and value-driven architecture decisions across central and local domains.
- Moderating architecture discussions and helping stakeholders find viable solutions that balance business needs, technological options and economic considerations.
- Building strong partnerships with business functions, IT teams, domain experts and architects across the organization.
- Advising business and IT teams on architectural best practices while ensuring alignment with defined Enterprise Architecture standards and guidelines.

What you can look forward to:

- role with real impact: you will help shape strategic domains and contribute to the future direction of Enterprise Architecture within an international group.
- A broad variety of exciting topics across business and IT, with the opportunity to work across organizational boundaries.
- The chance to create transparency, simplify complexity and enable better decisions in a dynamic transformation environment.
- A collaborative team culture where ownership, curiosity and pragmatic thinking are highly valued.
- The opportunity to act as a trusted advisor and enabler for business and IT stakeholders.

Your profile:

- Several years of experience in enterprise architecture, business architecture, domain architecture, IT strategy or a comparable role in a complex, preferably international organization.
- Understanding of enterprise architecture methods, target architecture development, architecture governance, principles and standards.
- Ability to translate business strategies and domain-specific requirements into clear, pragmatic architectural guidance without getting lost in unnecessary technical detail.
- Good understanding of current technological trends, innovations and state-of-the-art solutions, as well as their relevance for business transformation.
- Experience in facilitating architecture decisions and aligning different stakeholder perspectives across business, IT and architecture.
- A hands-on architecture driven mindset and the motivation to actively support architecture concepts from early idea to practical implementation together with business and IT teams.
- Strong communication, moderation and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex architectural topics clearly and convincingly to different audiences.
- Fluent German and English skills.
- Certifications such as TOGAF or equivalent qualifications are an advantage.
- You enjoy working independently, taking ownership and contributing as a motivated team player who wants to make a visible difference.

What we offer:

- Strong salary package - attractive base salary plus bonus and support for private pension plan
- Modern working time arrangements - time sovereignty without time recording, focus on results-oriented work
- Regular time off - 30 days annual leave plus up to 6 additional days off (company closures on bridge days and between years), special leave for specialoccasions, life phase account for paid time off (e.g. sabbatical, earlier retirement)
- Additional benefits - subsidized public transport, discounts in many (online) stores, company medical service with comprehensive preventive medical check-ups, sports facilities and employee canteen with freshly prepared meals every da
- Sustainability and social commitment - sustainability as part of the corporate strategy and targeted support for initiatives in the areas of education, family and science through our own foundations

Sounds like you?

Then we look forward to meeting you. Join us and help shape architecture that creates transparency, enables better decisions and supports the future development of the Heraeus Group.

jobs.description:
At Motherson, we’re committed to creating long-term jobs and advancing global careers. Featured on TIME’s World’s Best Companies list, we are a diversified global design, engineering, manufacturing, assembly and logistics specialist, delivering full-system solutions to customers across industries. With a focus on innovation, quality and sustainability, we strive to be a trusted industrialisation partner and an employer that nurtures a diverse, inclusive workplace.

Our global and regional headquarters act as key hubs connecting teams, businesses, and markets worldwide, supporting Motherson’s global operations and growth. These centres enable collaboration, facilitate informed decision-making, and provide the foundation for our diverse businesses. Join us to work in a dynamic global environment where your contribution plays a meaningful role in Motherson’s continued growth. 

Your tasks.

- Being the primary contact person for any legal related topics arising in any Business Unit in Germany and other jurisdictions assigned
- Provide legal and commercial advice to the Management and operational functions within the Group (e.g. Sales, Purchasing teams, Operations, Development, etc.)
- Advise on general pre-litigation and litigation cases and coordinate country-specific topics with specialized external lawyers and counsels
- Draft, analyze and solidify agreements, such as customer and supplier contracts, development agreements, etc. and support respective negotiations
- Assist, coordinate and consult in any kind of legal proceedings
- Liaise with external counsels across a wide range of subject matters, e.g. litigation, general commercial issues, in the most cost effective and efficient manner across Germany and the assigned jurisdictions

Your profile.

- Fully qualified lawyer. Deep knowledge in german law. Familiar with local and international laws and regulations
- Ideally initial experience in a similar role.
- Experience in the automotive and/or aerospace sector.
- Experienced in an international working environment. Ability to establish and maintain good working relations within a multicultural environment
- Flexibility, team spirit, ability to work under pressure, willingness to always learn
- Good Negotiation, communication and presentation skills
- Fluent English and German, another EU language is a plus

At Motherson, we’re committed to creating long-term jobs and advancing global careers. With a focus on innovation, quality and sustainability, we strive to be a trusted industrialisation partner and an employer that nurtures a diverse, inclusive workplace.

Our global and regional headquarters act as key hubs connecting teams, businesses, and markets worldwide, supporting Motherson’s global operations and growth. - Very good written and spoken German and good English skills

- comprehensive onboarding
- the opportunity to work in international teams

- a responsible position with excellent development opportunities

Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 110,000 employees.

Our values guide how we work:

- We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities

Your assignment:

- Complaints

Your profile:

- Bachelor of Science degree (B. S.) in Engineering, Chemistry, quality management or a comparable field
- Professional experience in quality management, ideally in supplier quality or supplier management
- Experience in analysing, evaluating and reporting on key performance indicators (KPIs)
- Practical experience in applying quality methodologies (e.g. 8D, root cause analysis, FMEA)
- Proficiency in using data analysis tools (e.g. Excel, SAP, BI tools) to create reports and dashboards
- Knowledge of quality management systems and tools (e.g. Trackwise or comparable systems)
- Experience with concentrates, sterile manufacturing, pharmaceutical raw materials, or critical components is desirable
- Training Experience is desirable
- Knowledge of ICH Q7, IPEC and GMP requirements, ISO 9001 and 13485 standards, QMSR/21CFR820 preferable
- Regional regulations, applicable to Medical and Medicinal Products (Device & Drug preferred)
- Experience with broad base of chemicals, excipients and APIs
- GMP in the manufacture of sterile products
- Project Management
- Excellent command of German and English; knowledge of Spanish and French would be an advantage

Our Offer for you:

There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, regardless in which field you are an expert and how much experience you have - all dedicated to your professional journey.

- Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world
- Individual opportunities for self-determined career planning and professional development
- A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking - to find the best solution together, not the quickest one
- A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience
- The benefits of a successful global corporation with the collegial culture of a medium-sized company

We are committed to diversity and equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Head (m/f/d) of Software Engineering & Architecture in R&D (Leiter/in - Softwareentwicklung)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building high-performing engineering organizations and shaping the future of digital product delivery? Do you enjoy combining strong technical understanding with people leadership, operational excellence, and transformation? 

In KWS SAAT SE & Co. KGaA Einbeck, we are looking for a  Head (m/f/d) of Software Engineering & Architecture in R&D to lead and further develop our digital engineering organization. As part of the R&D Digital Product & Technology Development leadership team you will drive the delivery of digital products, platforms, and services for R&D, while continuously improving engineering standards, delivery performance, quality, reliability, and productivity.  

You will play a key role in evolving our engineering setup into a more flexible, AI-enabled, and metric-driven organization that can respond dynamically to changing business priorities and accelerate innovation across KWS. 

Your Responsibilities 

As  Head (m/f/d) of Software Engineering & Architecture in R&D, you will shape the future of digital product delivery at KWS by building a high-performing and adaptable engineering organization that enables innovation on a scale. 

You will: 

- Lead and further develop the engineering organization responsible for delivering digital products, platforms, and services that support our global R&D activities.
- Drive engineering excellence by creating an environment where teams can deliver reliable, secure, and high-quality solutions with speed and impact.
- Build a future-ready organization by advancing modern ways of working, strengthening engineering capabilities, and unlocking the potential of AI across the development lifecycle.
- Foster strong partnerships across business and technology functions while ensuring effective collaboration with external vendors and service partners.
- Inspire, coach, and empower leaders and teams, cultivating a culture of accountability, continuous learning, innovation, and inclusion. 

Your Profile 

You are an experienced technology leader (m/f/d) who enjoys developing people, shaping organizations, and turning ambitious ideas into business value. 

You bring: 

- Proven leadership experience in software engineering, digital product development, or technology-driven organizations.
- A track record successfully leading complex products, platforms, or transformation initiatives in dynamic environments.
- Strong understanding of modern engineering practices and the ability to translate strategic goals into effective execution.
- Experience driving organizational change and building high-performing teams through trust, empowerment, and collaboration.
- Curiosity for emerging technologies, including AI, and a passion for continuously improving how engineering teams work and deliver value.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with fluency in English. German is a plus. 

What You Can Expect 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape a strategically important engineering function at the interface of digital technology, R&D, and innovation. You will work in a global environment and contribute to strengthening the digital capabilities that support KWS’ future growth. 

You can expect: 

- A leadership role with global scope and high strategic relevance.  
- The opportunity to shape modern engineering standards, practices, and operating models  
- Highly motivated internal teams of software developers working in synthony with external teams
- A strong support to enable new technologies, like AI, and to develop future-ready digital capabilities
- Close collaboration with digital products, technology, R&D, and business stakeholders
- A working environment that values collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and innovation 

Join Us 

If you are excited about leading engineering transformation, enabling high-performing teams, and shaping the future of digital product delivery in an innovative R&D environment, we look forward to receiving your application. 

**Grow your career with KWS and help us build the digital capabilities of tomorrow.**

As a Quality Engineer (m/w/d) for inspection planing in Hamburg-Finkenwerder, you take responsibility for inspection planning, quality standards and the continuous improvement of processes in a demanding technical environment. The position is filled through employee leasing and offers a structured entry into a highly relevant quality role.

- You define, create and release inspection specifications for quality assurance and ensure clear standards for daily use.
- Control plans are developed and continuously optimized so that inspection processes remain effective and traceable.
- Complex quality issues are analyzed systematically, including the identification of potential error sources with FMEA.
- Multi-functional teams are coordinated to drive improvement projects and implement quality measures across interfaces.
- Inspection strategies are reviewed and refined with a focus on process stability, efficiency and compliance.
- Process descriptions are prepared and maintained to support consistent execution and alignment with internal standards.
- Practical problem-solving methods such as 9S and SPC are used to support structured root-cause analysis and sustainable improvements.
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

This role suits a technically minded profile with a structured working style and a strong interest in quality, inspection planning and process improvement. A solid foundation in engineering, manufacturing or quality-related topics is important, together with the ability to work independently and communicate clearly across different teams.

- Completed technical qualification in engineering, technology, aerospace, mathematics or a comparable field at technician, specialist or higher level.
- Experience in manufacturing engineering, quality management or quality assurance is an advantage, ideally with a focus on inspection processes.
- Knowledge of FMEA and APQP is required for this position.
- Practical experience with SPC is an advantage, especially for structured analysis and quality control.
- Confident handling of MS Excel and SAP supports the daily work in planning, documentation and evaluation.
- Working with Google Workspace and related digital collaboration tools is expected.
- Very good German skills and strong English skills are needed for communication in an international environment.
- Technical drawing reading is required, while programming knowledge in Python or SQL is a plus.
Benefits:

- An unlimited employment contract
- 35-hour workweek
- 30 days of annual leave
- An annual salary of around 70.000 €
